notes: Version 11.47. New: simple sign-in. You now sign in with your account - your email and password - and this computer takes its seat under its own name; there is no license key to type. Your plan lives on your account, the sign-in screen shows the name this computer will appear as, and Settings keeps the Sign out of the account button from 11.45, which frees this computer's seat so another computer can sign in. This build also carries the background-check fix from 11.39: a built-in system part can no longer be called bad - or cleared - by an old saved check. The phone build is 11.9.18.
